newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES aims cut Russian electricity rates to industry.
newsitem.headline: UES aims cut Russian electricity rates to industry.

text.p: Russian national electricity company UES intends to cut tariffs to manufacturing industry by 13 percent this year, First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov said on Tuesday.
Nemtsov, speaking at a news conference, quoted UES president Anatoly Dyakov who earlier addressed a government meeting on restructuring UES.

Russian electricity rates to industry are generally higher than household rates, which is not the case in most industrial countries, and critics have said industry is being forced to subsidise politically popular low household rates.
UES operates the national electricity grid and wholesale market, has majority shares in most regional electric companies and has stakes in a number of power generating plants.
